name: sensei_agent_for_loop
description: Agent handler with for loop over array parameter parses successfully
input:
type AssessmentResult
  passed: Bool
  prediction: Text
  expected: Text
  gap_topic: Text

exportable agent forge_sensei
  memory
    interaction_count: Number

  on batch_assess(tests: Text[], expectations: Text[])
    passed = 0
    total = 0
    for test in tests
      total = total + 1
      say "testing"
    say "done"
